row: Dr. Lera @ Heron Lakes Animal Hospital

Dr. Abel Lera DMV is the owner of Heron Lakes Animal Hospital.

We are a full-service animal hospital specializing in dogs & cats since 2005. Dr. Lera acquired HLAH in 2013. He is a graduate of Mississippi State University and the University of Florida. Our team, lead by him, performs veterinary medicine and compassionate animal care in the Coral Springs/Parkland area in South Florida. 

This channel's purpose is to educate, inform & help. We cover a wide variety of topics regarding dogs and cats' medical issues, common concerns, treatments and more. We are always willing to take any suggestions from our viewers, so please feel free to contact us with any of them.

DISCLAIMER: The content provided in this channel is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your veterinarian or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.

Don’t forget to SUBSCRIBE!
